newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico same-day peso closes soft on U.S. long bond.
newsitem.headline: Mexico same-day peso closes soft on U.S. long bond.

text.p: Mexico's same-day peso closed 0.7 of a centavo weaker on Thursday at 7.4880/7.4920 per dollar under pressure from rising U.S. Treasury 30-year bond rates, traders said.
"Investors follow the (U.S. long) bond rate very closely, but even so the peso held up well, although the session was dull," one trader said.

The long-bond yield increased to 7.07 percent around midday Thursday as lower-than-expected joblessness and vigorous construction figures rekindled fears of rate hikes at the Fed's upcoming Open Market Committee meeting.
Meanwhile, the benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour stablemate were 1.4 and 0.7 of a centavo weaker at 7.5040/7.5090 and 7.4930/7.4980, respectively.
